# kleros/kleros-v2 @kleros/kleros-app@3.1.0

Changes since @kleros/kleros-app@3.0.1, released 2026-07-27.

## New

- Scout profile link
- Support-for-is-subscribed-query
- Confirmation-modal-pre-vote-and-commit
- Local-stack-orchestration-script
- Pinnig-feature-to-run-specific-contracts-version-locally

- Do-not-assume-justification-absence-reason

- Failing-cmds-and-update-script-network-requirement

- Add-network-check-in-sync-abis
- Fail-local-stack-script-if-port-is-not-free

- Remove-eval-extraction-in-favor-of-dedicated-config-and-json-extraction
- Update-template-readme-docs-and-popuplate
- Export-paths-and-publishing
- Do-not-throw-on-no-encoder-present
- Empty-frontend-url-check
- Default-attributes
- Return-the-safe-attachment-url
- Tighten-nft-image-fetch-and-render
- Frontend-url-check-with-warning-modal
- Remove-style-attribute-and-input-tag-from-rehype-allowlist
- Log level for keeper bot errors
- Remove max-len warnings across workspace

## Docs
